from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
L2=np.log(1+P)**2
G={
 'P^p(1-P/K)^q': (lambda p: P**p[0]*np.abs(1-P/p[1])**p[2], [1,5,1]),
 'P(1-P/K)exp(-P/m)': (lambda p: P*(1-P/p[0])*np.exp(-P/p[1]), [5,5]),
 'P(1-P/K)/(1+P/m)': (lambda p: P*(1-P/p[0])/(1+P/p[1]), [5,3]),
 'P(1-P/K)(1+m P)': (lambda p: P*(1-P/p[0])*(1+p[1]*P), [5,0.1]),
 'P log(1+P)(1-P/K)': (lambda p: P*np.log(1+P)*(1-P/p[0]), [5]),
 'P(1-P/K)^2 /P^? ': (lambda p: P*(1-P/p[0])**2*(1+p[1]*P), [6,0.1]),
 'P(1-P/K)exp(-m/P)': (lambda p: P*(1-P/p[0])*np.exp(-p[1]/P), [5,0.1]),
 'P^2(1-P/K)/(1+mP)': (lambda p: P**2*(1-P/p[0])/(1+p[1]*P), [5,0.5]),
 'P(1-P/K)^p': (lambda p: P*np.abs(1-P/p[0])**p[1], [5,1]),
}
res_all=[]
for name,(g,p0s) in G.items():
    best=None
    rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
    for s in range(25):
        p0=np.array(p0s,float)*(1+0.3*rng.normal(size=len(p0s)))
        try:
            def resid(q):
                X=np.column_stack([1/P,L2,t*g(q[2:])])
                c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
                return X@c-y
            r=least_squares(resid,np.concatenate([[0,0],p0]),max_nfev=400)
            v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(y)
            if best is None or v<best[0]: best=(v,np.round(r.x[2:],4))
        except Exception: pass
    res_all.append((best[0],name,best[1]))
res_all.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
for r in res_all: print(r)
